primary.description: Primary brand color used for interactive elements and focus states

text.description: Text color hierarchy for headings, body, and secondary content

border.description: Border colors for dividers and component edges

semantic.description: Semantic colors for alerts, badges, and status indicators

spacing.description: Spacing scale for padding, margin, and gaps

radius.description: Border radius values: sm for components, md for cards, full for pills

typography.description: Typography scale for headings, body text, and small text

notes.colorDrift: Multiple grays used interchangeably (#6b7280, #6c7280, #71717a, #737373) due to component/utilities inconsistency
notes.legacyStyles: legacy.css contains the original stylesheet; vars.css started a 2024 rebrand but was only adopted by settings screen
notes.inlineStyles: Button components (LinkButton, DestructiveLink), Card (HighlightCard), Alert (InlineError, FieldHint), and Calendar contain hardcoded inline styles for one-off uses
notes.consolidation: Extracted unified token set from: vars.css (rebrand attempt), base.css (typography), components.css (main components), utilities.css (ad hoc utilities), legacy.css (original), and component inline styles
